RR-B01.finding: A POSIX setitimer stage guard is applied to each immutable seed/node entry, with no same-grant retry or method change after timeout.

RR-B02.finding: BoundedStagingWriter enforces a cumulative 1 GiB content-byte ceiling and a final staged-package byte check before atomic promotion.

RR-B03.finding: The hardened target captures the previously missing primary, independent-backend, constraint, convergence, spectral, diagnostic, admissibility and candidate-profile channels, and the transaction binds candidate profile digests before result.json commit.

RR-B04.finding: Runtime attestation records CPU/platform identity and NumPy/SciPy BLAS/LAPACK configuration with exact dependency versions.

new_blocking_findings.title: IMMUTABLE_EXISTING_OUTPUT_PATH_CHECK_OCCURS_AFTER_SOLVER_EXECUTION
new_blocking_findings.observed: The hardened transaction calls target.execute_physical_schedule(capability) before it constructs and checks result_dir.exists(). Therefore an already-existing immutable output path can consume the single-use grant and execute the physical solver before the collision is detected.
new_blocking_findings.risk: A run forbidden by the frozen immutable-output policy could consume the unique grant and numerical resource budget before failing for a condition that must be detected before solver initialization.
new_blocking_findings.closure_condition: Derive every transaction/canonical output path from the validated grant before grant spend and solver import; fail closed on any collision before solver initialization.

new_blocking_findings.title: ONE_THREAD_RESOURCE_LIMIT_NOT_FAIL_CLOSED_BEFORE_BLAS_INITIALIZATION
new_blocking_findings.observed: validate_runtime() builds BLAS/LAPACK metadata by importing NumPy/SciPy before enforce_process_limits() sets thread environment variables. validate_runtime also accepts the thread variables as UNSET. A BLAS runtime can therefore initialize a multi-thread pool before the later environment assignment to 1.
new_blocking_findings.risk: The future physical solve is not guaranteed to obey the frozen one-CPU-thread execution envelope even though the attestation/CI path passes.
new_blocking_findings.closure_condition: Require the thread-control environment to equal 1 before importing NumPy/SciPy or any numerical backend, and positively attest the effective numerical thread-pool limit before grant spend.

new_blocking_findings.title: TOTAL_WALL_CLOCK_LIMIT_NOT_CONTINUOUSLY_ENFORCED_DURING_TARGET_FINALIZATION
new_blocking_findings.observed: Per-entry timers constrain the 35 schedule entries, but the target performs _finalize(...) after the schedule loop without an active total wall-clock timer. execution_elapsed_wall_clock_seconds is measured only after finalization; the transaction can detect a negative remaining packaging budget only after the total limit has already been exceeded.
new_blocking_findings.risk: The frozen maximum total wall-clock duration is an accounting check rather than a hard upper bound during the target finalization phase.
new_blocking_findings.closure_condition: Maintain one independent total-deadline guard across schedule execution, target finalization and immutable result packaging, while retaining the nested per-entry deadline semantics.

new_blocking_findings.title: PREREGISTERED_HIGH_PRECISION_BORDERLINE_AUDIT_PATH_ABSENT
new_blocking_findings.observed: The hardened target can classify a binary64 N=96 candidate as NUMERICAL_CANDIDATE_BACKGROUND_DIAGNOSTIC using the frozen threshold gates, but there is no 80-bit-or-greater re-evaluation path or fail-closed borderline classification before acceptance.
new_blocking_findings.risk: A numerically borderline candidate could be accepted without satisfying a preregistered precision requirement.
new_blocking_findings.closure_condition: Define a non-post-hoc borderline band before execution and implement an 80-bit-or-greater audit for candidates entering that band, or fail closed to a non-accepted classification when the audit is unavailable.

new_nonblocking_findings.title: EXTERNAL_QUARANTINE_DIRECTORY_IS_NONCANONICAL
new_nonblocking_findings.observed: The hardened transaction commits the external quarantine package under results/<grant_nonce>, while the frozen result schema names artifacts/hzt-m0/md2s/background3c/<run_id>/<authorization_decision_id>/. The manifest records a future byte-for-byte promotion target, but no promotion transaction is yet implemented.
new_nonblocking_findings.required_action: During the next hardening pass, derive a quarantine hierarchy that mirrors run_id/authorization_decision_id and add an audited byte-for-byte promotion verifier or explicitly freeze the quarantine-to-canonical mapping.
